title: Motegi Control Tower
geometryBasis: Named OpenStreetMap tower footprint tied to operator plan, GSI bare-earth grade, and the exact original author-dedicated Qualla photograph.
sectionBasis: The tower has a stacked silver-clad box, darker corrugated return, a broad open roof terrace and a tall metal switchback stair above its recessed entrance.
limitations: Models the standalone control tower. The adjacent long pit garages and the separate speedway buildings sit outside scope.
The inset stair framing and facade colors follow the 2008 photograph. Rear openings, small equipment and exact floor heights are approximate.
